parsed_json.sql: SELECT md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, a.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles, td.target_type, td.tax_id, act.standard_type, act.pchembl_value FROM activities act JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON a.tid = td.tid JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON act.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON act.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL260' AND td.target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN' AND td.tax_id = 9606 AND act.standard_type = 'IC50' AND act.standard_relation = '=' AND act.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL ORDER BY md.chembl_id, a.chembl_id
